{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
duplicated_patients = trial_data.groupby('patient_id').size() > 1
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {duplicated_patients.sum()}")

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
trial_data = trial_data.loc[trial_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the biomarker_baseline column
print(f"Shape after deduplication: {trial_data.shape}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {trial_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()}")

# Also check for sentinel values
sentinel_value = -999.0
print(f"Number of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {(trial_data['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()}")"}
